parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the creation time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the results.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the creation time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: TaskAction
parameters.description:
The name of the API operation associated with the task. Valid values:

- ImportImage: import an image.
- ExportImage: export an image.
- RedeployInstance: redeploy an ECS instance.
- ModifyDiskSpec: change the cloud disk type.
- ArchiveSnapshot: archive a snapshot.

parameters.name: TaskGroupId
parameters.description:
The task group ID.

> This parameter is in invitational preview. When this parameter is specified, other query conditions do not take effect.

parameters.name: TaskIds
parameters.description: The task IDs. You can specify up to 100 task IDs at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- Finished: The task is complete.
- Processing: The task is running.
- Failed: The task has failed.

Default value: null.

> Only tasks in the Finished, Processing, or Failed state can be queried. Other values do not take effect.
